description: Two PreToolUse guards on Bash and PowerShell, so neither shell is a way around them. format-gate: blocks a commit when source files changed since the formatter last ran (formatting rewrites every mtime, so it runs once at the end, and this keeps it honest). bash-guard: blocks a force push without a lease, and a tree-wide formatter run that has not been acknowledged. One SessionStart hook, compile-commands: puts a CMake checkout's compile_commands.json at its root (its build tree's own, else the Hub's with the paths moved, as Helm does), and tells Claude when it still has no usable one, so it does not trust a language server running on guessed flags.
